name: Montenegro
summary: Possession for personal use is a misdemeanour (fine €100–2,000), not a crime; using drugs in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days. Supply is a crime (2–10 yrs).
poisonControlNote: No poison information centre is listed in WHO's 2023 directory; call 112 or 124.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law or other specific legal protection for people who call for help in an overdose was found.

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms presumably treated likewise. Own-use possession: misdemeanour.

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I; cacti status not confirmed. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

dox.note: DOM, DOB, DOC: UN Schedule I. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I since 2015. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

2c-t-x.note: Not UN-controlled; whether the national NPS rulebook lists 2C-T compounds was not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not UN-controlled; whether the national NPS rulebook lists 5-MeO tryptamines was not confirmed.

cannabis.note: Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days. Producing or selling: crime (2–10 yrs).

ketamine.note: Anaesthetic; national control status not confirmed (not UN-controlled).

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not internationally controlled; no national restriction confirmed.

amphetamines.note: UN Schedule II. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

cocaine.note: 1961 Convention drug. Own-use possession: misdemeanour fine €100–2,000; use in public: fine €100–1,000 or up to 30 days.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II (own-use possession: misdemeanour). GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin etc.: own-use possession is a misdemeanour (€100–2,000). Rx opioids: prescription only.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only; possessing such medicines without a prescription is a misdemeanour (fine €100–2,000).

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only; possessing such medicines without a prescription is a misdemeanour (fine €100–2,000).

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala/Syrian rue status not confirmed; ayahuasca contains DMT.
